function.name: spawn_agent
function.description: Launch a full tool-using child asynchronously, or inspect/cancel its operation. Currently supports autonomous Codex parents and Codex headless children in a retained isolated Git worktree from committed HEAD; dirty parent edits are not inherited. Explicit backend/model/workspace/prompt required for spawn. Returns an operation_id, not a completed result. Child results are durably routed to the launching conversation. Local backends, headed launch, explicit shared workspaces and native app-server parents are blocked pending integration. One managed child globally; no managed grandchildren. Existing lightweight subagent is separate. Status/cancel IDs are scoped to this running parent process; durable outcomes remain retained after restart.

operation_id.description: Required for status/cancel; omit for spawn.

workspace.description: Existing Git repository; child uses an isolated worktree at committed HEAD.

reasoning_effort.description: Must be advertised by the connected provider for the selected model; mutually exclusive with thinking_level.
